results.title: ABC Technologies Acquires TI Fluid Systems To Form $5.4B Global Automotive Supplier - Design Engineering
results.content:
It’s a merger that signals a strategic consolidation with an aim to expand product offerings and enhance supply chain integration for fluid handling systems. With operations now spanning 27 countries and a customer base that includes all major automotive manufacturers, TI Automotive is positioned to serve a broader range of mobility solutions, especially in EV thermal management, fuel delivery and advanced materials. [...] It’s a move that no doubt strengthens Canada’s role in next-generation mobility solutions and reinforces its presence in the global automotive supply chain. And, according to TI Automotive president and CEO Terry Campbell, it also represents an opportunity for the newly amalgamated company to enhance its solutions even further.

“The combination creates exciting opportunities to drive innovation and manufacturing excellence, while establishing the foundations for our future growth.” [...] Canadian automotive parts supplier ABC Technologies recently completed its acquisition of TI Fluid Systems, forming a new global entity known as TI Automotive with a combined annual revenue of $5.4 billion and a workforce of 34,600 employees across 26 countries around the world.
